title: Add Theseus dashboard cross-project smoke fixture
summary: Added a cross-project dashboard smoke fixture that runs reusable dashboard commands against a temporary configured host workspace, and fixed dashboard reports to use configured host project ids.

sourceRefs.summary: Creates a temporary host workspace and verifies dashboard-data, dashboard-out, validate, and action metadata across project roots.
Accepts configured project ids when rendering dashboard data, HTML, and served HTML.
Passes workspace project ids into report command handling.
